titre: Le marché mondial de la mémoire flash quadruple
sous_titre: Chiffre d'affaires cumulé des cinq premiers fournisseurs, en Mds $, par trimestre civil

T3 2025.texte: the combined revenue of the top five NAND Flash vendors grew by 16.5% QoQ, approaching US$17.1 billion

T4 2025.texte: The combined revenue of the top five NAND flash suppliers sharply rose 23.8% QoQ to US$21.17 billion.

T1 2026.texte: the combined revenue of the world's top five NAND Flash suppliers jumped 83.7% QoQ, surpassing US$38.9 billion

T2 2026.texte: the combined revenue of the top five publicly listed NAND Flash brands rose 77% QoQ to US$68.87 billion.
